Diablo 4 Paladin Build (Holy Purifier) Holy Bolt Build Lord of Hatred Guide
In this Diablo 4 build guide, I'm going to be showing you my Holy Purifier Paladin build for Diablo 4 Lord of Hatred. This is a really fun build to play that revolves around the use of the Holy Bolt skill as well as purify and what I like about this build is it's very easy to get going. It doesn't have resource management issues, so it's great for leveling as you're playing Paladin and getting into the earlier levels of torment.
